collection_site: Shahid Chamran Heart Center, Isfahan, Iran

analysis_cohort.positive_definition: Any of 15 artery segments is in 51-75, 76-90, 91-99, or 100 percent stenosis categories.
analysis_cohort.negative_definition: Every artery segment is NL, 1-25, or 26-50 percent stenosis.
analysis_cohort.endpoint_compatibility: AngioCAD positive bins start at 51%, matching the source positive cut point of >50%. The target's negative 26-50 bin includes the 50% boundary but does not retain exact percentages within that bin, so exact-50 cases cannot be isolated for a boundary sensitivity analysis.
analysis_cohort.target_column: Derived from artery label workbook, columns LM through PLB; feature and label workbooks joined on patient ID.

harmonized_features.mapping: Years, retained as numeric; missing values imputed using source-fit median.
Male/female normalized to male/female strings; source 1=male and 0=female.
Binary fasting blood sugar >120 mg/dL; same strict threshold applied to numeric external measurement, assuming AngioCAD numeric FBS is mg/dL.
harmonized_features.unit_evidence: The workbook does not state units. Observed values range from 55 to 514, consistent with mg/dL; this remains an explicit harmonization assumption.

excluded_fields: All other AngioCAD fields are excluded, including diagnosis, medication, labs beyond FBS, and artery labels. The target is not supplied as a predictor.
overlap_assessment: AngioCAD is from a separate Iranian hospital; source components are Cleveland, Hungary, Switzerland, and VA Long Beach. The workbooks have site-specific IDs but no cross-dataset person identifiers, so direct patient-level overlap exclusion is unavailable.
attribution: Hosseini, M. S., Naghsh-Nilchi, A. R., Safayani, M., et al. (2026). AngioCAD: A public X-ray angiography dataset and an adaptive fusion framework for stenosis detection. Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine, 282, 109368. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cmpb.2026.109368. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15826856.
